name: Effect: Strix Vengeance

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
Granted by Strix Vengeance

You deal an additional 1d6 precision damage on Strikes against the marked creature. The bonus increases to 2d6 if you use a striking weapon or unarmed attack and 3d6 if you use a major striking weapon or unarmed attack.
